notes:
Lead profile: SMB support/SaaS company focused on live chat + knowledge-base summarization. Self-serve trial converted to inbound support ticket complaining about sluggish chat replies.

Customer words: "During our morning support peak the bot feels slow — customers hang up if reply > 1.2s." Wants quick wins before committing.

Observed workload: bursty traffic 8am-11am PT, typical request size ~200-350 tokens (prompt + expected response), heavy use of retrieval-augmented generation for KB lookup. No strict data residency requirement, prefers hosted API to avoid infra ops.

Perf/requirements summary: p50 target <250ms for single-turn answers, p95 target <800-1000ms acceptable for now; throughput target ~200 reqs/min peak; cost sensitive (monitor per-token spend), prefers model variants that balance cost/latency (e.g., smaller Llama-family or quantized versions).

Tuning suggestions shared so far: region testing (us-east-1 vs us-west-2) — traffic originates primarily from west coast customers; increase client timeout for streaming fallback; switch to streaming responses to reduce perceived latency; trim system prompts and long retrieval contexts; enable prefix KV caching on repeated session interactions; set max_tokens cap for quick answers; consider batching on server side for lower unit cost during off-peak.

Security: requests must go through SSO for admin console and audit logs enabled. Customer comfortable with SOC2-level assurances but hasn't requested a full compliance pack yet.

Sales notes: early-stage opportunity — SMB self-serve with clear pain around latency. Upside to convert to annual hosted contract if 2-3 tuning changes bring p95 under 800ms. Next step: run a 2-week perf POC comparing two regions and a smaller model variant (provide benchmark script + sample dataset).

Open action items: provide region-specific latency benchmarks, sample timeout/config snippets (SDK + curl), cost estimate for 200 reqs/min with median 300 tokens, schedule POC kickoff (aim week of 2026-03-22).
workload_summary: Primary workload = chat support widget (RAG augmented). Peak = 200 reqs/min, avg tokens/request ~280. Priority = perceived latency (streaming) then cost. Model preference = hosted small/medium open models; fallback to higher-capability model only for complex queries.
perf_requirements: Targets: p50 <250ms, p95 <800-1000ms. Must test us-east-1 and us-west-2. Client timeout default to 20s for initial POC; encourage streaming with chunk_size 64 tokens. Recommend max_prompt_length 800 tokens and enforce response max_tokens 150 for common intents.
